mechanism: Radial Regularization Stage-1 only smoke (R92-Diagnostic 驱动). 加 L_rad = mean_{l,k} [max(0,ρ_min-ρ)² + max(0,ρ-ρ_max)²] 区间约束, ρ_min=0.20, ρ_max=0.70, λ=1e-3. Stage-1 50k steps (smoke, 不跑 Stage 2/3/4).
summary:
v92 Stage-1 radial regularization smoke 完成. 用户授权的 4 个 gate 评估结果:
  Gate 1 (ρ↑) PASS: ρ mean 0.07-0.10 → 0.51-0.55 (7x baseline). codewords 推到 [0.20, 0.70] 安全区间中段.
  Gate 2 (Spearman corr↓) PASS: c=2 L0 0.9997→0.9137, c=5 L0 0.9866→0.3374. curvature 现在真影响 pairwise rank-order.
  Gate 3 (assignment change rate↑) PARTIAL: c=2 L0 2.34%→4.92% (改善但<10%), L1/L2 几乎没变化.
  Gate 4 (residual-reference distortion↑) FAIL: L0 0.16→0.03 (反效果!), L1 0.30→0.08 (反效果), L2 0.21→0.11 (反效果). 量化破坏 residual relationship 比 baseline 更严重.

按用户决策框架: '如果 radial activation 后, 不同 c_l 能够明显降低这个 distortion, 那么论文故事就完整了. 如果这些成立, 但 residual-reference distortion 还是完全没有改善, 那么下一步就非常明确: A 不够, 需要 A + D (Radial Activation + Relational Distortion Loss).'

Gate 4 fail → 不进 Stage 2/3/4. Stage-1 R50 (产物保留供 v93 复用). 启动 v93 = A + D (Radial Activation + Relational Distortion Supervision).
